title: Feature file v2.0.0
description: `features/<name>/feature.json`: the committed assignment `workflow launch <name>` prepares. `workers` declares every lane: a node id that must match a `workers[].node_id` of the policy file and the task file that lane receives. `launch --workers a,b` selects a subset; omitted means every declared lane. A 1.0.0 file (`ui_task`/`adapter_task`) is translated to this shape by `launch` and reported as deprecated. Hand-written; the controller validates it with `workflow.verification.validate_schema("feature", ...)` and additionally requires unique node ids, the same id set as the policy and existing, non-empty task files inside the feature directory.

policy.description: Policy file relative to the feature directory (contracts/workflow/verification.schema.json).

node_id.description: A lane id as the policy declares it: lower-case, at most 32 characters, never a reserved graph name, attribution or per-lane prefix.

task.description: Task file relative to the feature directory.
